open_obligations: Check that the nip losses are indeed not zero-sum in the sense Chen et al. intend.
Note that Hammond et al. train with expert iteration, not regret minimisation.
Check whether Chen et al.'s oracle-based regret results apply to these games.
in.other_title: nip protocol: one prover and one verifier with worst-case losses
in.rationale: Chen et al. limit their experiments to zero-sum games and call general-sum language games an interesting direction. Hammond and Adam-Day define nip with the prover's loss as worst-case positive-instance loss minus worst-case negative-instance loss and the verifier's loss as their sum, so the game is not zero-sum, and run such protocols with GPT-4o provers on code validation.
in.scope: proposed ADDRESSES: whether language-model oversight games beyond zero-sum debate can be formalised and run, for prover-verifier games with LLM agents
